name: promotional-card
title: Promotional Card
description: A compact card for promotional content with icon, decorative background, title, description, and optional link. Uses namespace exports: PromotionalCard.Root, PromotionalCard.Icon, PromotionalCard.Decoration, PromotionalCard.Content, PromotionalCard.Title, PromotionalCard.Description, PromotionalCard.Link, PromotionalCard.Composed.

docs.lead: A compact card for promotional content with an icon, decorative background element, title, description, and optional link. Supports stroke and filled variants.
docs.usage:
import * as PromotionalCard from "@/components/ui/promotional-card"

<PromotionalCard.Root>
  <PromotionalCard.Icon as={RiFilter3Line} />
  <PromotionalCard.Decoration as={RiFilter3Line} />
  <PromotionalCard.Content>
    <PromotionalCard.Title>Let me filter</PromotionalCard.Title>
    <PromotionalCard.Description>Apply filter based on what you exactly need</PromotionalCard.Description>
  </PromotionalCard.Content>
</PromotionalCard.Root>

examples.title: Stroke
examples.description: The default stroke variant with white background, border, and subtle shadow. The decoration icon is nearly invisible for a clean look.
examples.code:
<PromotionalCard.Root variant="stroke">
  <PromotionalCard.Icon as={RiFilter3Line} />
  <PromotionalCard.Decoration as={RiFilter3Line} />
  <PromotionalCard.Content>
    <PromotionalCard.Title>Let me filter</PromotionalCard.Title>
    <PromotionalCard.Description>Apply filter based on what you exactly need</PromotionalCard.Description>
  </PromotionalCard.Content>
</PromotionalCard.Root>

examples.title: Filled
examples.description: Filled variant with a gray background, commonly used for brand promotions.
examples.code:
50% discount on Spotify
For only $4.99 per month! Learn More

examples.title: Clickable
examples.description: Cards rendered as links using asChild with clickable cursor styling.
examples.code: Let me filter Apply filter based on what you exactly need

examples.title: Composed
examples.description: Shorthand composed version that accepts all content as props.
examples.code:
<PromotionalCard.Composed
  variant="filled"
  icon={RiSpotifyFill}
  title="50% discount on Spotify"
  description="For only $4.99 per month!"
  linkText="Learn More"
  linkHref="#"
/>

examples.description: Multiple promotional cards in a grid layout.

api.name: PromotionalCard.Root
api.description: The main card container with overflow clipping.

props.name: variant
props.description: The visual style of the card

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot, useful for wrapping in links or buttons

api.name: PromotionalCard.Icon
api.description: Small icon positioned at the top-left of the card. Polymorphic.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render as

api.name: PromotionalCard.Decoration
api.description: Large decorative icon at the top-right, partially clipped. Polymorphic. Opacity varies by variant.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render as

api.name: PromotionalCard.Content
api.description: Container for title and description row, positioned at the bottom of the card.

api.name: PromotionalCard.Link
api.description: Optional underlined link, placed as a sibling next to Description.

api.name: PromotionalCard.Composed
api.description: Shorthand version that composes all subcomponents via props. Accepts all Root props.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon component for the top-left

props.name: decorationIcon
props.description: Override for the decorative background icon. Falls back to icon
